name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_firstMoment
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta g : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < eta →
          0 < g →
            g < 1 / ↑k →
              ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (hN0 : 2 ≤ N0),
                ∀ (N : ℕ) (hNN : N0 ≤ N) (L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (D : ℕ)
                  (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                    RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts ⋯ (2 * eta) →
                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g (eta / 10) omega →
                        ↑N ^ (eta / 10) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                          (∃ (a : Fin (L + 1)),
                              ↑a = ↑x.fst ∧ TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts ⋯ a) g) →
                            RiffleUpperV2.expectedCommonEdges
                                (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega)
                                  x omega) ≤
                              ↑N ^ (-eta / 8)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_concentration
type:
∀ (xi : ℝ),
  0 < xi →
    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
      2 ≤ N0 ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ),
          N0 ≤ N →
            ∀ (k L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))
              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g xi omega →
                ↑N ^ xi ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                  RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x / 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧
                    ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ 2 * RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ∧
                      2 ≤ (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧
                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ N ∧
                          ∀ (hm : 0 < (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card) (j : Fin (L + 1 - ↑x.fst))
                            (a : Fin k),
                            |TimeProfile.prob
                                    (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega) x omega)
                                      hm j)
                                    a -
                                  ↑(cuts.count (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.suffixColumn x j) a) / ↑N| ≤
                              2 * ↑N ^ (-xi / 3)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_preservation
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta g : ℝ),
      0 < eta →
        0 < g →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            2 ≤ N0 ∧
              ∀ (N : ℕ),
                N0 ≤ N →
                  ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (D : ℕ)
                    (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                    ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                      RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts ⋯ (2 * eta) →
                        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g (eta / 10) omega →
                          ↑N ^ (eta / 10) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                            (∃ (a : Fin (L + 1)),
                                ↑a = ↑x.fst ∧ TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts ⋯ a) g) →
                              2 ≤ (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧
                                (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ N ∧
                                  ∀ (hm : 0 < (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card),
                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstColumnGood
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega) x omega)
                                        hm (g / 2) ∧
                                      RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N (↑x.fst)
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts
                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega) x omega)
                                        hm eta

type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
      0 < (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card →

              1 - RiffleUpperV2.empiricalA N 0 cuts ⋯ 0 ↑x.fst + Real.log 2 / Real.log ↑N
